default.unsupported_reason: Catalogued integration is not certified for the self-contained Windows v0.1.0 release. It remains disabled until a reviewed Windows/runtime contract, license or redistribution decision, checksum pin where applicable, and non-invasive liveness verification are committed.

shodan.unsupported_reason: Requires user-supplied Shodan credentials and an explicitly configured external service/API workflow; no Shodan binary is bundled.

censys.unsupported_reason: Requires user-supplied Censys credentials and an explicitly configured external service/API workflow; no Censys binary is bundled.

etherscan.unsupported_reason: Requires an authenticated Etherscan API workflow rather than a redistributable Windows binary.

corellium.unsupported_reason: External commercial service requiring a separately authorized tenant and credentials.

mobsf.unsupported_reason: Supported only as a separately deployed and explicitly configured service/container; it is not silently installed by the desktop release.

aquatone.unsupported_reason: Upstream project is archived. Retained for historical catalog compatibility only.

jsparser.unsupported_reason: Registered upstream JSParser depends on Python 2.7 and is incompatible with the production runtime.

waffw00f.unsupported_reason: Duplicate/suspect spelling. Windeep canonicalizes the maintained integration as wafw00f.

sublist3r.unsupported_reason: Legacy Python dependency stack is not certified for the packaged Windows runtime.

burpsuite.unsupported_reason: Commercial/independent application; Windeep does not redistribute or silently install it.

owasp_zap.unsupported_reason: Independent Java desktop/runtime dependency is not part of the self-contained v0.1.0 package.

nmap.unsupported_reason: Nmap/Npcap redistribution and driver installation require separate license/admin review before bundling.

tshark.unsupported_reason: Wireshark/Npcap driver installation requires separate consent, license, and elevation handling.

metasploit.unsupported_reason: Large independent runtime is not certified for the self-contained Windows release.

remix.unsupported_reason: Remix is a browser IDE/link rather than a deterministic portable Windows CLI artifact.

class_dump.unsupported_reason: macOS/iOS host tooling; no native Windows execution contract.

ios_deploy.unsupported_reason: Requires macOS/iOS host tooling; not Windows-compatible.

checkra1n.unsupported_reason: Host/device workflow is not compatible with the Windows desktop release.

frida_server.unsupported_reason: Device-side binary is target OS/CPU specific and must be deployed explicitly to an authorized test device.
